original_test_intent: Inspect and exercise one approved BMC firmware-firewall rule at the specified channel/LUN/NetFn/command scope, prove enforcement, and restore the exact baseline without losing recovery access.
original_method: Use the vendor-supported firewall interface only after full ordered-rule baseline, least-privilege policy, connectivity probes, atomic rollback and independent recovery are approved.
manual_activity: Security owner approves the single rule/enforcement matrix; operator confirms the independent console/recovery route immediately before applying it.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects guessed rules; OOB history allows a conditional, approved scoped implementation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Vendor-approved atomic firewall runner with exact selectors, full diff, connectivity probes and guaranteed restore.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the complete ordered policy, validate recovery, confirm one rule, apply atomically, verify both allow and deny enforcement plus management health, restore the exact baseline and preserve audit.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines bounded functional coverage without editing the TBD Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only rule inventory cannot replace the required enforcement change; one rule does not validate all firewall policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Bad order/defaults can lock out BMC recovery or expose management.

project_override_considerations: Tool choice is Project-specific, but it must preserve selectors, order, effective enforcement, complete diff and recovery.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master is fully TBD and asks to clear logs, conflicting with security-change audit; no rule scope/default/order or criteria exists.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The functional firewall goal and OOB implementation family are clear; exact vendor schema, policy and recovery are execution inputs, not an irresolvable review contradiction.

review_improvement: Keeps functional enforcement coverage and adds atomicity, lockout prevention, bidirectional probes and exact rollback.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a high-risk management-plane state change. It requires an approved package and point-of-action recovery confirmation, but should not be permanently BLOCKED merely because Project-specific rules are absent; REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION is appropriate.
